professionalSummary.text: Gathers and documents requirements from sales leadership for CRM changes.
professionalSummary.witness: ran requirement workshops with the regional sales directors and turned the outcomes into user stories for discount-approval changes, each with acceptance criteria agreed with the directors before build.

experienceHighlights.text: Configures approval workflows in the CRM or quoting tool.
experienceHighlights.witness: Configured a three-tier discount approval workflow in the quoting tool, sending quotes above 15% discount to the regional director and those above 30% to the finance director's office.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Has taken a configuration change through a change process into the live CRM and reported on its use after release.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Moved the discount approval workflow into the live CRM on 11 March 2024 under change request CR-2207, after testing in the full-copy sandbox, and monitored quote approval times for six weeks after release.

skills.text: Maintains a data dictionary for CRM fields.
skills.witness: Kept the opportunity-field data dictionary current, recording the owner, picklist values and reporting use of each of 140 fields, and circulated the monthly changes to the reporting team.
